recipes.name: Peanut Butter & Jelly Overnight Oats
instructions: Add the oats, milk, peanut butter, chia seeds, and cinnamon to a mason jar or airtight container. Mix to combine.
Then add the frozen berries, and gently mix again. Seal and let sit overnight in the fridge.
The next morning, add your desired toppings and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
